## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap should be reduced to five because the default and validation ceiling exceed the governing project policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds a retrying fetch helper and tests for recovery, exhaustion, and attempt limits. It also proposes raising the documented cap to ten and adds a hostile-review fixture.

(none)

## Important
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap retry attempts at five — When an upstream keeps raising `OSError`, the default call makes ten attempts, exceeding the governing limit. `AGENTS.md:5` requires: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” Your default and validation ceiling both allow ten. — During an upstream outage, callers can issue twice the permitted requests, increasing load and delaying failure.
